notToBeConfusedWith.name: Scotch
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Made in a different country under different rules; Japanese distillers historically followed Scotch methods closely but the two are not the same category.

forms.label: Standard, e.g. Suntory Toki
forms.sourceNote: Alcoholic beverage, distilled, all (gin, rum, vodka, whiskey) 80 proof. Public domain. FoodData Central carries no Japanese-whisky-specific record and composition does not vary with grain or region at a fixed proof, so this generic distilled-spirit record applies unchanged; ABV is set to 43%, the strength Suntory Toki is bottled at and the reference bottle this highball is usually built around.
